question: In which of the following forts was Razia Sultan imprisoned by Malik Ikhtiyar-ud-din Altunia?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Qila Mubarak in Bathinda.**__

__
 
• **Qila Mubarak fort served as a prison for Empress Razia Sultana after she was defeated by her rebellious general, Malik Ikhtiar-ud-din Altunia.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Razia Sultana Born: 1205 ​Reign: 1236 – 1240**

 
 
• She was Iltutmish’s daughter.
 
• She is also the **first and last Muslim woman** to **rule over Delhi.**
 
• She was defeated by Malik Ikhtiar-ud-din Altunia, the governor of Bathinda.
 
• After which sultana was prisoned at Qila Mubarak fort.
 
• She later married to Malik Ikhtiar-ud-din Altunia.
 
• She was reportedly killed by her brother’s forces.
 
• She was succeeded by her brother Muizuddin Bahram Shah.​
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Golconda fort in Golconda**

 
 
• ​Golconda Fort is** built by the Qutb Shahi dynasty** as the capital of the Golconda Sultanate,** located in Hyderabad, Telangana, India.**
 
• This is one of the most magnificent fortress complexes in India. 
 
 
 
• **Mehrangarh fort in Jodhpur​**
 
 
• **​Mehrangarh Fort in Jodhpur was built by Rao Jodha, **who was** the founder of Jodhpur city.** 
 
• Considered** one of the most formidable and magnificent forts of Rajasthan,** was built in the **year 1459. **
 
 
 
• **​Jaigarh fort in Jaipur **
 
 
• **​Jaigarh Fort is known as the victory fort **which was** built by king Sawai Maan Singh III in 1726.**
 
• It was built in order to protect the amber fort and the palace complex within it.
